card.name: Inside chemical names, plus signs
card.fires_on: Partway through chemical or drug names, such as the 'acy' in triacylglycerols or 'yl' in acyl-glucuronide. It also fires on a plus sign after a symbol, as in CD4+, Ph+ or Mg++.

modes.label: Inside chemical names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long chemical or lipid name, such as acy or yl.

modes.label: Plus after a symbol
modes.description: A plus or double plus marking a cell type or ion charge.
modes.example: Suppression of CD4<<+>> cell counts has been observed

card.plain: It marks the middle of long chemical names and the plus sign in terms like CD4+ or Mg++.
evidence: Suppression of CD4<<+>> cell counts has been observed
